ICDAR 2023 IHTR Bengali words WRR: Upstage PARSeq 96.10, PERO 92.02, light(TrOCR) 91.62, SRUKR 88.06; organisers' CVIT baseline 75.34. PARSeq>TrOCR on Bengali.

Handwriting Expert recipe: PARSeq per script initialised from 11 IndicPhotoOCR checkpoints on disk (.deps/IndicPhotoOCR, MIT); fine-tune on IIIT HW with ICDAR winner recipe synthetic/scene init -> multilingual real -> per-script FT; optional train-lexicon LM rescoring.
Pre-registered kill (a): test set not IIIT-like if stratified 100-image view shows <80% single handwritten words (13/13 so far).
Pre-registered kill (b): specialists don't transfer to new writers; kill if fine-tune <85% WRR on independent-writer set (BN-HTRd or ICDAR test). ICDAR'23 test is 100 new writers yet scored 96.10.
Kill (c) leakage: if official images subset of IIIT train split, exclude and disclose; edge then rests on independent-writer numbers only (G-HW0 pHash+SHA of 5,344 vs every candidate set).

Independent-writer eval sets: BN-HTRd (Mendeley 743k6dm543; 108,181 Bangla words, 150 writers; licence TO CHECK) and ICDAR 2023 IHTR val/test ('academic-use' per ledger) = EVAL ONLY. Synthetic Pango/HarfBuzz+OFL fonts = pretraining only.

Licence contradiction: AIKosh says CC BY 4.0 vs ledger 'academic-use' for competition sets -> train only on AIKosh CC-BY release; competition sets eval-only. PARSeq Apache-2.0, BN-HTRd, IIIT bn test count, IndicPhotoOCR weight licence are snippet-only/unverified.

HW2 gates: target >=92% WRR IIIT bn val and >=85% independent writers; <85% after 2 epoch-equivalents -> switch to CRNN+LM (PERO-style) or PARSeq-base; Mac MPS feasible, 24 GB GPU faster; LM rescoring kept only if WRR rises. Gujarati needs extra care (ICDAR best 62.80).
